characters.name: Pete Eckhart
characters.description: Brilliant, but Lazy: He tends to half-ass everything that isn't related to fantasy football. Deadpan Snarker: He has a sarcastic sense of humor and gets a lot of quips. Everyone Has Standards: While working as a referee, he refuses to accept a bribe from Jenny to fix the outcome of Ellie's soccer match. Heterosexual Life-Partners: With Kevin. Dirty Randy mistook them for actual life partners, and Ruxin plays it up by naming his fantasy football team "Pete Top, Kevin Bottom". Informed Ability: His prowess at fantasy football is often alluded to, but rarely shown. Despite starting the series as a three-time champion, he is the only member of the main cast besides Taco not to win the Shiva during the series, though he does win a $1,000,000 prize in a fantasy football contest in the series finale.

characters.name: KevinMacArthur
characters.description: Amazon Chaser: In "The Light of Genesis", his female Krav Maga instructor's fighting prowess awakens his "fear boner". Amoral Attorney: During the early episodes, though this gradually moved to him being moral but incompetent. Berserk Button: Missing out on a chance to win the Shiva (though only in the early seasons before he finally wins it all), being reminded that his wife is a better fantasy football player than he is, or any mention of the "fear boner" are just some of the more prominent examples of the many things that set him off during the course of the series. Butt-Monkey: In addition to things usually going badly for him, the only time he won the Shiva, he had to give up his Commissioner's position to keep it from being thrown out. Groin Attack: ARunning Gagas Kevin on the receiving end through the series:In "The White Knuckler", Taco accidentally throws anaginatathat grazes his penis."Ol' Smoke Crotch" has him set his pubic hair on fire when he dyes his graying bush and then tries to speed up the process with a hair dryer.Finally, in "The Great Night of Shiva" has him actually castrated when Jenny throws the Snip (a trophy consisting of a pair of golden scissors) in anger as he is rounding the corner to speak to her.

characters.name: Rodney Ruxin
characters.description: Alliterative Name:RodneyRuxin. Alsohis father Rupert and sister Rebecca. Amoral Attorney: Primarily works as a corporate lawyer for the most amoral of clients (serving as part of BP's legal team during the 2010 oil spill). When Kevin shows up at his office to get his advice on lying, Ruxin tells him he doesn't need to whisper as "lying is encouraged here". Batman Gambit: Ruxin is very good at these. One particular incident involves knowing the size of Andre's little fatty bylying to Shiva by using his position as Commissioner to take her picture off of the trophy. However, it involves a full league vote to make a decision. Shiva found out after she told him, and Ruxin made no attempt to change their minds. Cannot Convey Sarcasm: Between his deadpan delivery, the general idiocy of those around him, and the fact that he's almost always being sarcastic, Ruxin sometimes has this problem, especially when dealing with Taco or Rafi. Catchphrase:"Forever Unclean!"when something disgusting happens to something/someone around him. To a lesser extent, accusations of collusion,to be fair, he was right at first."Everybody calls me Ruxin" is his default response to be addressed by his first name.

characters.name: Andre Nowzick
characters.description: Believing Their Own Lies: Andre genuinely thinks that his hair is clear and that he has enough to comb when he is alone rather than accept being bald. Butt-Monkey: As noted in his description. The rest of the League generally spend a quarter of every conversation taking the piss out of him.Iron Butt-Monkey: In season 6, Andre's luck suddenly takes a turn for the better despite the usual amount of shit that life and the League throw his way, leading to rest of the League frustratingly referring to him as "Teflon-dre", as nothing seems to stick to him. Iron Butt-Monkey: In season 6, Andre's luck suddenly takes a turn for the better despite the usual amount of shit that life and the League throw his way, leading to rest of the League frustratingly referring to him as "Teflon-dre", as nothing seems to stick to him. Camp Straight: Andre acts pretty effeminate at times, but he's a straight guy. Cannot Tell a Joke: Andre's jokes rarely, if ever, manage to draw a laugh from the rest of the group. He resorts to taking a standup class (for the second time after flunking out on his first try) in "The Bringer Show".

characters.name: TacoMacArthur
characters.description: Achievements in Ignorance: Taco somehow won the Shiva before the start of the series. For context, Taco knows very little about football, constantly sets lineups that are illegal (i.e. more than one kicker, players who are injured or aren't even on an NFL roster), and seemingly has very little interest in the league, whereas everyone else treats fantasy football with an almost-religious fervor.He somehow ends up owning the domain name for the Dallas Cowboys website, selling it back to Jerry Jones for $250,000. He somehow ends up owning the domain name for the Dallas Cowboys website, selling it back to Jerry Jones for $250,000. Americans Are Cowboys: In one episode, Taco landed a role on anAlgerian soap operacalledSands of Passionas Buck, an American pastiche and self-described "rapper-slash-cowboy-slash-cautionary tale" dressed like a cowboy. Catchphrase: Buck, Taco's Algerian soap opera character, likes to say "Bang! Bang! What's the hang?". Cloud Cuckoolander: The weirdest member of the group, mostly due to himbeing perpetually stoned.

characters.name: JennyMacArthur
characters.description: The Ace: She's a strong candidate for best player in the League: she nearly guides Kevin's team to the Shiva in 2009 (undone only by Kevin tinkering with the lineup she set), reaches the Shiva Bowl in her first year as a player (with a team Rafi drafted), won the Shiva in 2013, and is the only main member of the castnotto get the Sacko. Ambiguously Bi: Taco discovers and reveals that Jenny had sexual relations with another woman while in college, which she is deeply embarrassed about. She also fantasizes about Shiva while masturbating once. Caught with Your Pants Down: In "Training Camp", Jenny is sexually frustrated due to Kevinrefusing to have sex with her while she's pregnant, so she resorts to masturbating in her parked car (while fantasizing ofShivano less). She orgasms whilescreaming Shiva's name, only to realize the guys are crowded around the car window, much to her embarrassment. Clingy Jealous Girl: Jenny is not usually the jealous type and doesn't care if Kevin watches porn or finds some other woman hot, but one episode has her getting jealous of Kevin's attraction to Sofia. Height Insult: Unintentionally done in one episode; Jenny subconsciously equates a person's height with their importance, so much so that the guys take to calling her a "height supremacist". When Kevin introduces her to his boss (who isveryshort), Jenny assumes he meant the taller man standing next to him and proceeds todig herself deeperafter being corrected.

characters.name: Vince
characters.description: The Ghost: Unlike the other Out-of-Towners, he never showed up in person and was only mentioned by name once when Kevin informs the rest of the League that he left the League, necessitating a new player to take his place.

characters.name: Chuck
characters.description: The Alcoholic: He was an absolute trainwreck before he left town. When the League meets him again, he's in recovery and tries to get them to give up alcohol as well. By the start of season 5, he's back in rehab. Dry Crusader: When reconnecting with the rest of the League after getting sober, Chuck tries to push them giving up alcohol as well, though he eventually relents that he can't change them. Embarrassing Nickname: The rest of the League referred to him as "Two-Nut Chuck" due to his habit of pulling his testicles out in public. The Topic of Cancer: In the Season 7 premiere, he reveals that he has testicular cancer.

characters.name: Ted
characters.description: The Casanova: The guys describe him as a "lady killer" in college... which unfortunately results with him having AIDS in the present. Dark Horse Victory: He wins the Shiva Bowl after the real Shiva curses the entire season, making him the only out-of-towner to win the Shiva. Informed Judaism: The only time he is confirmed to be Jewish is when a rabbi performs his funeral. Lethally Stupid: He was too busy trash-talking the rest of the League over the phone while stepping into the street to notice the oncoming car that kills him. Tragic Aids Story: He is revealed to have AIDS, though this is subverted as he is killed by a car whileFaceTimingKevin.

characters.name: Russell
characters.description: Extreme Omnisexual: Doesn't matter if its a man, woman, or block of cheese, he'll stick his penis in anything that'll let him once something triggers his addiction. Lust Makes You Dumb: His inability to curb his sex addiction leads to him sticking his dick in a wheel of cheese in the middle of his restaurant on its opening night, horrifying the customers and destroying the business before it even gets off the ground. Off the Wagon: He lapses back into sex addiction in season 6. Single-Target Sexuality: Inverted; despite otherwise being anExtreme Omnisexual, Russell has no attraction to Jenny whatsoever.

characters.name: Sofia Ruxin
characters.description: Buxom Beauty Standard: Being so well endowed is why his friends thinks they're in aUgly Guy, Hot Wifepair. Even theHappily MarriedKevin can't help but let out a "Wow" when he sees her in a bikini. Clingy Jealous Girl: Sofia forbids Ruxin from watching porn, for she considers it cheating. She even gets mad when she finds out he masturbates to a picture ofher. Dating What Daddy Hates: Her father makes antisemitic remarks about Ruxin while accusing Rafi of putting her off dating Puerto Rican men. Dropped a Bridge on Him: She's unceremoniously killed in the final season when undergoing a vaginal rejuvenation surgery, which is played forBlack Humorsince Ruxin cares so little he just uses it as an opportunity to scam wins out of his fantasy league. Lysistrata Gambit: Withholding sex is Sofia's most common way of punishing Ruxin.

characters.name: Rafi
characters.description: Brother–Sister Incest: Rafi is shown several times to be sexually attracted to his sister Sofia, something she seems to be oblivious to and simply thinks he's being very affectionate. Ruxin is very disturbed by it, and Rafi's father blames him for putting Sofia off Puerto Rican men. Cloud Cuckoolander: Rafi is absolutely bonkers, has no boundaries, and is always doing and saying things that are super extreme and inappropriate. Guest-Star Party Member: Was part of The League for the first four episodes of season 2. They quickly regret this and have to trick him into leaving. Jerkass: He is far worse than the League, which is really, really saying something. The Sociopath: The man has no limit to what he will do.

characters.name: Dirty Randy
characters.description: Improbable Weapon User: Once threatened Ruxin with a trident made of dildos. Pungeon Master: Believes puns are vital to the porn business. Scary Librarian: He works as a librarian when not making porn, and is certifiably insane. That Man Is Dead: He was once an architect and germaphobe who jokingly referred to himself as "Clean Randall". Then he accidentally caused his best friend to fall off the building he'd designed (crushing Rafi's wife and kids in the process) and was subjected to multiple rounds of electroshock therapy by a sadistic nurse at a mental institute until all traces of his former self are gone, leaving only Dirty Randy behind.

characters.name: Shivakamini Somakandarkram
characters.description: Alliterative Name:ShivakaminiSomakandarkram! The guys even seem to enjoys saying her full name oftenbecauseof this. Loving a Shadow:Played With. The main characters allobjectify and idolize her, from naming their championship trophy and adorning it with memorabilia of her to invoking her name as if she's some kind of exotic goddess. The real Shiva finds all of this very gross and points it out that the members of the league barely know her real self. But they don't care. Ms. Fanservice: The main character's nerd classmate who grew up to be a massiveHospital Hottie. This is why the main characters named their trophy after her and overall treat her like aLust Object. Progressively Prettier: If the high school yearbook photo of her that adorns her namesake trophy is anything to go by, Shiva was something of aStereotypical Nerdgrowing up before she blossomed into the sexpot she's depicted as in the present. Sex Goddess: Shiva herself isidealized to be one in the minds of the main characters, although from the little we see of her relationship with Andre, sheisactually pretty good in bed.

characters.name: Rupert Ruxin
characters.description: Alliterative Name:RupertRuxin. This also extends toson Rodney and daughter Rebecca. Consummate Liar: Ruxin accuses him of teaching him everything he knows about lying to his wife. Deadpan Snarker: A trait he shares with his son. Dirty Old Man: Both of his appearances have him flirting with (and in one case, having sex with) women young enough to be his daughters. Last-Name Basis: He thinks "Rupert" is anEmbarrassing First Nameand insists on being addressed by his surname. His son, Rodney, has the same problem.

characters.name: Heather Nowzick
characters.description: Andre's sister and, in Pete's words, "an unremitting slut-bag". Ambiguously Bi: After Jenny turns down Heather's first two offers to re-teach cunnilingus to Kevin (either by watching Kevin perform it on Jenny or having Kevin perform it on her while Jenny supervises), Heather then offers to go down on Jenny herself while Kevin watches. Formerly Fat: Based on comments by the rest of the guys, Heather's lost quite a bit of weight since the last time they've seen her. The Mentor: She describes herself as Pete, Kevin, and Taco's "sexual mentor" and even propositions Jenny to give Kevin a few remedial lessons. Really Gets Around: She's had sex with Pete, Kevin, Taco, and Ruxin's father. Even Jenny isn't immune to her advances.

characters.name: The Kids
characters.description: Artifact Title: He's still called Baby Geoffrey long after he grows out of being one. Vocal Dissonance: Being exposed to Kevin's testosterone supplements causes him to enter puberty early, giving him a much deeper voice than a kindergartener should have. The Ditz: Implied; her own teacher refers to her as a "dullard" and claims she doesn't have the intelligence or creativity to have made the "human sexuality" pop-up book that she turns in for her sex-ed project. Though given that she doesn't have the sense to realize a pop-up book that depicts her father having sex with Pete is a wildly inappropriate school project even for sexual education, her teacher may have a point. Token Religious Teammate: In season 6, her parents start sending her to Sunday school (not for any religious reasons, they just see it as a free daycare on Sunday mornings), leading her to adopt a more religious outlook and accuse her parents of being sinners and fornicators that worship a false idol (the Shiva). Though the latter partisn't too far off the mark. Embarrassing First Name/Embarrassing Middle Name: AfterTacoacquires the naming rights to Kevin and Jenny's second child from Ruxin, he is given the name Chalupa BatmanMacArthur. His parents rename him Christopher Benjamin the following episode, though everyone refuses to call him by that name (even Kevin starts calling him Chalupa in the later seasons, to Jenny's annoyance).

characters.name: Ashley
characters.description: The Thing That Would Not Leave: Shortly after Sofia leaves town, Ashley starts neglecting her job when she starts sleeping with Pete. Ruxin wants to fire her, but sheblackmailshim by threatening to tell Sofia that he was masturbating to her photo (he was actually wiping pee off his pants, but nobody would believe him) unless he continues to pay her for doing nothing. So to get her to quit, Ruxin enlists asecondThing That Would Not Leave in the form ofRafi, believing him to be so disgusting and disturbing that Ashley would want to leave. Unfortunately for Ruxin, she actually gets''turned on by Rafi''and starts sleeping with him. Miraculously, the situation gets resolved when Rafi convinces her they're too good for Ruxin's house and move out, though Ruxin still has to explain to Sofia why their au pair quit while she was gone.

characters.name: Local Shop
characters.description: Alliterative Name: Tulip "Tubbs" Tattsyrup. Animal Motifs: Their piggy noses may have something to do with the family's bestiality towards pigs meaning that the reason for their strange noses are genetic. This is implied in the second episode of the first series where Tubbs is shown breast-feeding a piglet. The noses, and Edward's appearance in particular, may also be indicative of congenital syphilis. Arc Villain: Their attempts to foil the construction of new road is the main focus of series 1. Aren't You Going to Ravish Me?: Tubbs seems fearful of any man who enters the shop (not) doing this. Back from the Dead: Occurs twice.Having been presumably killed at the end of series two,they resurface at the beginning of series three from the ruins of the Local Shop, although are killed moments later from a train.Despite theirdeaths in series three, they return in the three part 2017 anniversary special, in which they claim the train had avoided them.

characters.name: The Dentons
characters.description: Abusive Parents: Not Val and Harvey, but the latter's own parents, who viciously mocked him due to his facial warts and gave him the nickname Toadface. Animal Motifs: Toads. That's all. Harvey lives and breathes to feed and sustain them, because of seeing himself as one of them. Back from the Dead:Uncle Harvey's soul is transferred into Benjamin during the Anniversary Special, though it's undone by the end of the special. Berserk Button: Harvey hates the "f-word" (frog) seeing them as knock-offs and competition apparently. Control Freak: Freaks is probably the word that first springs to mind when someone sees them, especially Harvey, but it is actually worse than that. They arecontrollingfreaks and are led into evil when they take their ways as far as keeping Ben as some sort of prisoner or pet in order to keep control of every aspect of his life. Harvey considers it something to be proud about enough to write a pamphlet that details this plan and name itMy plan to keep Benjamin as some sort of pet.

characters.name: Job Centre
characters.description: Alas, Poor Villain: Despite the fact she was his nemesis,Ross attended her funeral in the 2018 live show.Subvertedas the same live show reveals she's still alive. Subvertedas the same live show reveals she's still alive. Ambiguously Gay: Series 1 and 2 repeatedly and heavily imply Pauline is gay, at first her spotlight episode in series 3 is in line with this... Until she has sex with Mickey and thenRossof all people. By the end of the series she and Mickey get married. Back from the Dead: The 2018 live tour reveals that both her dementia andher deathin the Anniversary specials were faked as part of an insurance scam. Blatant Lies: In series 1 she confesses to Ross she never went to college but whileworking atBurger Mein series 2 she claims to have diplomas.

characters.name: Introduced in Series  1
characters.description: Arc Villain:It's his special stuff that causes the nose bleeds at the heart of series 2. Back for the Finale: He makes a brief appearanceevacuating the other women from the wife mine before it explodes in the "LIVE Again" tour. Bald of Evil: He's the villain ofseries 2and in the finale he shaves his head (except for the sideburns, of course) and flees to the Caribbean. Beard of Evil: Well, sideburns of evil. Bestiality Is Depraved: Mrs Briss is revealed to be a Jersey cow whom he nonetheless seems to treat as a proper housewife, given the long tearful goodbye that he gives her, along with the fact that she is housed in a specially designed part of the bed.

characters.name: Introduced in Series  2
characters.description: The Ageless: He doesn't seem to age. In the Christmas Special when he kidnaps Bernice's mother, he looks the same age as he does in the series. Back for the Finale:He returns in the final episode of the 2017 series, where it's revealed that he was the one behind the photobooth. Catchphrase: "You're my wife now!" and "Hello Dave!" Evil Is Hammy: He's one of the evilest characters (which issaying a lot)and also one of the most flamboyant and theatrical. Evil Plan: To turn peopleinto circus animals.Even though it would just be easier to just get someordinary circus animals.

characters.name: Introduced in Series  3
characters.description: A very unempathetic doctor who refuses to treat patients with anything more than the most common tablets unless their willing "go private" and earn their treatment by winning party games at his house. Bald of Evil: He is a balding and sadistic man who abuses his position as a doctor to sate his appetite for the misery of others, in more ways than one. Catchphrase:"Go out, would you?" Dirty Old Man: This appears to be his motive for inviting Mrs. Beasley over but isSubvertedas he only invites his patients over for party games to determine which one will receive treatment first. Dr. Jerk: The way he acts towards Mrs.Beasley in his first scene cements him as this. The way he acts towards his private patients later in the episode just amplifies it considerably.
